title: Buriram Marathon 2027 Review: Racing on Thailand's Formula 1 Circuit
seo_title: Buriram Marathon 2027 Review | Chang International Circuit Race
meta_description: The Buriram Marathon 2027 is set for January 23 at the Chang International Circuit — Thailand's F1 track. Full and half marathon on a motorsport circuit with registration now open.
dek: Set for 23 January 2027 at the Chang International Circuit in Buriram — Thailand's premier motorsport venue — this Chang Mineral-backed marathon offers full and half distances with registration already open. A road race on a racetrack: here's what that means and what to expect.
verdict: The Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral is one of Thailand's most distinctive road races by virtue of its venue alone: the Chang International Circuit, a FIM Grade 1 and FIA Grade 1 motorsport track that has hosted MotoGP and World Superbike events. Running a marathon on a racetrack means a billiard-table-flat course on pristine tarmac, with zero traffic, no pedestrian conflicts, and kilometre markers built into the circuit infrastructure. Two distances — full marathon (42.195km) and half marathon (21.1km) — keep it focused, and registration is already open. The January date in Buriram offers northeast Thailand's cool-season conditions. Suits runners who want a PB-friendly course with a venue story unlike anything else on the regional calendar.

sections.heading: The Venue: A Marathon on a MotoGP Circuit
paragraphs: The Chang International Circuit in Buriram is Thailand's premier motorsport facility — a 4.5km track that has hosted MotoGP, World Superbike, and the Asia Road Racing Championship. [1] Running a road race on a racetrack is a fundamentally different experience from a city marathon: the surface is engineered for high-speed vehicles, meaning flawless tarmac, precise camber, wide lanes, and zero potholes.

For a full marathon at 42.195km on a 4.5km circuit, runners will complete multiple loops — roughly nine full circuits plus connecting sections. That means a highly predictable course where you know exactly what's coming on every lap, aid stations can be positioned with race-car precision, and spectators can see runners multiple times from a single vantage point.

sections.heading: PB Potential: Flat, Fast, and Traffic-Free
paragraphs: A racetrack marathon is about as PB-friendly as road racing gets. The Chang International Circuit is engineered for speed — flat, smooth, with wide-radius corners that don't require the braking and deceleration of tight city turns. [1] There are no traffic lights, no pedestrian crossings, no cobblestones, and no surprise gradients. If you've been waiting for a Thai marathon where the course, not the climate, is the limiting factor, this is it.

That said, 42km on a circuit means repetitive scenery — you'll see the same grandstands, pit lane, and run-off areas multiple times. For some runners, the predictability is a mental asset (knowing exactly where each kilometre marker sits); for others, the lack of visual variety is a challenge. Know which type you are before signing up.

sections.heading: Registration: Open Now, Chang-Backed
paragraphs: Registration is currently open via burirammarathon.com, making this one of the few 2027 races you can sign up for today. [1] The Chang Mineral sponsorship — Chang is one of Thailand's biggest brands — means commercial backing for medals, race tees, aid stations, and post-race amenities.

Two distances are offered: a full marathon (42.195km) and a half marathon (21.1km). [1] The absence of a 10K or 5K keeps the event focused on distance running, which suits the racetrack format — a 5K fun run on a motorsport circuit feels like a mismatch, while a half or full marathon on the same surface feels like the main event.

sections.heading: Buriram: Thailand's Unexpected Sports City
paragraphs: Buriram, in northeastern Thailand (Isan), has transformed itself into the country's sports capital over the past decade — the Chang International Circuit, the Buriram United football stadium (Thunder Castle), and the Buriram Marathon have put a previously overlooked province on the international sports map. The city has good transport links, including Buriram Airport with direct flights from Bangkok, and a growing hotel infrastructure built around its sports-tourism economy.
January in Buriram is cool-season Isan: morning temperatures in the mid-to-high teens, lower humidity than coastal Thailand, and minimal rain. It's as good as marathon weather gets in the country.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a Thai marathon with a genuinely unique venue, a flat-and-fast course, and cool-season conditions, the Buriram Marathon is one of the strongest picks on the 2027 calendar. The racetrack setting is something no other Thai race offers, and the January date and open registration make it bookable now. [1]

The looped circuit format won't suit everyone — if visual variety matters to your race experience, factor that in. But if your goal is a PB on pristine tarmac with zero traffic stress, this is the one. The 2027 edition is set for 23 January at the Chang International Circuit, Buriram. [1]
